t: This is the Savoy Theatre, on the Strand. It opened on 10 October 1881, on the site of the old Savoy Palace, and it was built for Richard D'Oyly Carte. His aim was to showcase the popular comic operas of Gilbert and Sullivan, which became known as the Savoy operas. The architect was C. J. Phipps, who designed more than forty theatres in the late nineteenth century. So you're looking at a building made for one specific purpose, giving a home to a famous partnership.
